notes.content: Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major, with the exception of CHEM 1A, which requires a "C" grade or higher. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Biology is compatible with the B.S. in Biological Sciences - General concentration at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better. CHEM 24 and 124 may be taken in lieu of CHEM 20. Please note: CHEM 124 is an upper-division course that must be completed at Sacramento State. For additional information, please visit: Department of Biological Sciences .
notes.contentHtml:
1. Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major, with the exception of CHEM 1A, which requires a "C" grade or higher.
  2. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Biology is compatible with the B.S. in Biological Sciences - General concentration at Sacramento State. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better.
  3. CHEM 24 and 124 may be taken in lieu of CHEM 20. Please note: CHEM 124 is an upper-division course that must be completed at Sacramento State.
  4. For additional information, please visit: Department of Biological Sciences.
